durations.title: Match duration
durations.mineEmpty: No matches with a duration yet
durations.communityEmptyHint: Appears once enough matches are shared.
durations.note: Both averages come from matches recorded in MeepleBoard. The BGG duration comes from the BoardGameGeek entry and never enters them.
durations.loadError: The duration could not be loaded.
durations.yoursNote: Matches far from the rest count in the average.
durations.communityNote: The same value for everyone. Rounded to 5 min; for matches far from the rest only the count is shown.
durations.fewValues: Median and middle half appear with 5 or more matches.
durations.protectionNote: Each group shows the MeepleBoard average only with at least 5 shared matches, from 3 or more people, none with more than half. A minimum protection, not a guarantee of anonymity.
durations.howMean: Average: sum of durations divided by the number of matches. Each match counts once.
durations.howMedian: Median: the middle value, with the matches in order.
durations.howMiddle: Middle half: between the 1st and 3rd quartile; half of the matches are in this range.
durations.howDistant: Far from the rest: more than 1.5 times the width of the middle half below the 1st or above the 3rd quartile. They count in the average.
durations.howOut: Left out: «Not sure», matches without a duration and old 0 min durations. Never counted as zero.
durations.howNotStated: Method not stated: older matches with a duration, recorded before the app asked whether it was timed or estimated. Not treated as estimates.
durations.howCommunity: MeepleBoard average: only matches where every participant agreed to contribute; each match counts once.
durations.contributes: Your matches in the MeepleBoard average
durations.bggNote: The BGG duration ({{value}}) comes from the BoardGameGeek entry and is not used in these calculations.

ratingsInfo.howMean: MeepleBoard rating: the average of all ratings of this game's matches. Each match someone plays counts once for that person, so those who play more contribute more. It is not an average of averages.
ratingsInfo.howCounts: Ratings and players: how many ratings count and from how many different people.
ratingsInfo.howNames: No names: the average shows no names or matches. With few ratings, someone who knows who played may work out ratings. Only what you publish appears with your name.
ratingsInfo.howUnofficial: Unofficial matches (forced mode) are not in this average; they are in yours.
ratingsInfo.howMine: Your average: the average of all your ratings of this game, including unofficial matches.
ratingsInfo.howBgg: BGG: the BoardGameGeek rating, kept apart; not used in these figures.
